name: Hear Nothing See Nothing Say Nothing

podcast.body: This is the title track from Discharge's 1982 debut album, exemplifying D-Beat, a hardcore derivative. The band and this song were highly influential on metal bands like Metallica, Anthrax, Slayer, and Sepultura. "Here's the title track for their 1982 debut album, Here Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This is the title track from Discharge's 1982 debut album. As one of the original D-Beat bands, this song and album were highly influential on prominent metal bands like Metallica, Anthrax, Slayer, and Sepultura. "Here's the title track for their 1982 debut album, Here Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing. Discharge, hardcore for sure, but also a very big influence on metal bands like Metallica, Anthrax, Slayer, and Sepulchura."
